title: A unified framework for existing and new constructions of Neumaier graphs
summary: A Neumaier graph is a non-complete edge-regular graph containing a regular clique; it is called strictly Neumaier if it is not strongly regular. In this paper we present a construction using finite rings that unifies several known results and yields three new families, each containing infinitely many strictly Neumaier graphs. We characterize when the resulting graphs are strongly regular. The family obtained from norm functions of finite field extensions includes the collinearity graphs of generalized quadrangles of \(*\)-Tits type arising from the classical hyperoval.
